newsitem.title: USA: Action Industries sees higher FY96 net loss.
newsitem.headline: Action Industries sees higher FY96 net loss.

text.p: Action Industries said on Monday it expected a significant increase in its net loss for the year ended June 30, compared to last year.
Action said in a statement its net sales fell 33 percent in the fiscal 1996 year, to about $30.2 million. The company lost $2.9 million from continuing operations last year.
Action, which was not immediately available to comment further, said net sales for the fourth quarter ended June 30 were about $5.7 million, about 50 percent below the same period last year.
Fourth quarter net losses were expected to be proportionate to or greater than those experienced in the nine month period, the company said.

Action said also said it would delay filing its Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended June 30, because it was negotiating two material contracts which would have a significant impact on its balance sheet and statement of operations.
The company previously said it had entered into a nonbinding letter of intent to sell the inventory and intellectual property related to its replenishment and promotional business.
Action said the estimated loss in connection with the sale of inventories and intellectual property would be reported in the fourth fiscal quarter.

Action also said it expected to complete a new lease on its headquarter facility in the next week to 10 days. The rent would be about $100,000 per year for five years under an operating lease and would relieve the company of a previously reported $7 million capital lease obligation for the facility, it said.
